title: Task dependency listing
description: Which Tasks file belongs to which Story of the span (<work>/task-deps-inputs.json), handed to the task-dependency-mapper as `task dependency listing`. The step `task_edges.listing` (orchestrator/flows/task_edges.py) writes it and validates it against this file. It points to the files; it copies none of them: each Tasks file (tasks.schema.json) holds its Story's Tasks with their same-Story edges, and the closure edges file (closure-edges.schema.json) holds the edges the matrix already makes between Stories.

stories.description: The Stories of the span in span order. A Task's key across the span is `<story>-<local key>`, the form task-deps.schema.json names.

repoPath.description: The repository the Story builds in.
